thread:
nina: Quick kickoff - we need a short, actionable migration note for v1->v2 API and model swap. Goal: one-page checklist + tiny code snippets (TS + Python) that show shape differences (models -> model, responses API) and a streaming example. Also call out embedding and usage field renames. Can someone own the snippet PR?
raj: I can do the snippets. Proposal: main docs show canonical v2 usage only; add a small 'transition shim' in the migration appendix.
taylor: Legal flagged the timeline: 60-day deprecation window required. Ops wants the PRs in by EOD so we can schedule the announcement after next deploy.
olive: I'll search the repo for v1 endpoints and old SDK pins. I'll post a list of affected pages in ~2h.
ci-bot: ci: docs lint check passed on branch patch/cleanup-refs (no-code changes).
raj: Draft snippets below. TS v2 minimal: 
```ts
const r = await client.responses.create({
  model: 'redwood-1b',
  input: 'Write a short blurb about the product update.'
})
console.log(r.output[0].content)
```
Python v2 minimal: 
```py
res = client.responses.create(model='redwood-1b', input='Write a short blurb about the product update')
print(res.output[0].content)
```
raj: Streaming note: use client.responses.stream(callback) instead of completions.stream. Example in the streaming guide will show chunk framing and reconnect tips.
raj: Short function-call example (TS):
```ts
const resp = await client.responses.create({
  model: 'redwood-1b',
  input: 'If user confirms, call the invoicing tool',
  tools: [{ name: 'invoice', description: 'create invoice entries' }]
})
// implement tool handler to process tool calls
```
olive: Scan result: 9 doc pages link to /api/v1/models, 2 quickstarts use `completions.create`, 4 sample apps pin older SDK versions. I'll open PRs to update references and tag for review.
taylor: Add to checklist: verify billing metrics after migration (note: `token_count` renamed to `usage.tokens`, embeddings endpoint moved to /embeddings). Also include automated smoke tests: call responses.create with a small prompt and assert 200 + expected fields.
nina: Good. For the deprecation notice text keep it short: 60 days from publish, contact support for assisted migration, rolling fallback policy explained (v2 requires explicit model_variant; recommend explicit fallback models in config).
ci-bot: ci: new PRs created - #512 update-doc-links, #513 sample-apps-migrate, #514 snippets-v2.
raj: I'll add a tiny compat helper in the migration appendix: map old call shape to new one and show how to wrap streaming results. But main examples will be pure v2.
olive: I'll attach the grep output and file list in PR #512 for traceability.
taylor: Timeline: PR reviews today, merge tomorrow AM, schedule deprecation notice after next docs deploy. Thanks team.
